notes.title: The update time of the new version is changed to June 10
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251091/ec3364110cd835572e407e6abf152d49eb2b2724.jpg[/img]
Yes, we're late. We've always been punctual. The update time of the new version of "Liuyin" is changed to June 10. Because the game participated in the activity of living to death in May, the discount can only be opened again in June. In order to allow more players' grandfathers to play the game at a low threshold, we decided to postpone it to June 10. Thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: Game update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251091/fa0b61f720fe0033b08ab73a5d2577769a89fa40.png[/img]
adjustment
1. Yanteng mechanism time of zhenmocang Temple increased from 1.5 seconds to 2.5 seconds.
2. Spirit weapon thousand hands mode increases movement speed by 20%.
3. Double click the direction key to increase the reserved time by 35%.
4. Lightsaber thunderbolt buckle HP reduced from 30% to 15% and damage increased at the same time.
5. Increase flying immortal damage of lightsaber skill.

repair
1. Fix the problem of abnormal collision of some models in mocang temple.

Note: This update will detect the module before repair, which is expected to take about 5 minutes.

notes.title: Demo game update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39251091/48ae883992f6d90d8e2b35890937e022ae6ee71b.jpg[/img]
game updated

[Added] Added handle adapter function.

[Adjust] Adjust the prologue guide relationship.   

[Adjust] Adjust important inventory to display unknown TAB of mission information.  



Hint: the rest of the game has been adapted, except that the game Settings and knapsack are not fully adapted after a major adjustment. At the same time, the handle will be gradually optimized in the later stage. This update has changed the way important items and quest prompts are displayed in pages. Players are encouraged to explore the game, so the unknown important items, materials, recipes, etc. that are available in the version are displayed in the form of question mark tabs in advance for players to unlock. Have a good game, everybody.
